entries.summary: 70.6 on SWE-bench Verified from a 9B model would be remarkable if independently confirmed. It is not: the number is DeepReinforce's own five-run average, published eleven days ago, on a model trained against tasks it generated for itself.

mitigations.note: No fix — a caveat. If you need a coding model you can trust at this size today, the scores on this site with independent backing are lower and older.

entries.summary: No Q2–Q3 build is published for this size, so the smallest practical download is the 5.8GB Q4_K_M. That is fine on 16GB and awkward on 8GB, where the 4-bit weights plus a working context leave very little room.

mitigations.note: On an 8GB machine, pick a smaller model rather than a smaller quant of this one — the quant does not exist.
